blocks.html: Cainta, Rizal, Philippines (April 2024) - RLC Residences, the residential division of real estate giant Robinsons Land, recently celebrated the topping off ceremony of the first two buildings of Phase 1 of Sierra Valley Gardens.

Present during the celebration and leading this milestone are the executives and key team members of RLC Residences, along with the representatives from construction partners Terp Asia Construction Corporation, ArkNet Inc., and W.V. Coscolluela & Associates.

The event marked the development’s achievement of reaching the top floors of Sierra Valley Gardens’ Buildings 1 and 2. Launched in 2020, the development is one of RLC Residences’ fastest-selling condominium properties, thanks to its strategic location inside the Sierra Valley Estate in Cainta, Rizal. Aside from this, the property showcases well-thought-out amenities and innovative features such as smart deliverables in every unit.
